brand.nameDecision: Selected with the owner; formal brand and domain availability checks are a separate release task.

purpose: Ajudar cada pessoa a escolher o que assistir conforme gosto, momento e tempo disponível, organizar sua trajetória audiovisual e encontrar opções oficiais para assistir.

scope.classification: Separate structural kind (movie, series, short, special) from genre, animation medium, audience and origin. Anime and documentary may describe either a film or series; classify one canonical record rather than duplicating it.
scope.playback: Discovery and personal organization with outbound official viewing links; complete films and episodes remain with their licensed providers.
scope.personalization: Keep recommendations based on declared tastes, curated evidence and personal behavior. Do not fabricate personal ratings for newly imported titles.

lastNativeAudit.scope: Exact ea3a5ac pilot audit; new public-access code is locally tested, unchanged native storage awaits any final candidate checks.

androidPhysicalDevice.evidence: Owner confirms update with old data retained and Breaking Bad watching/T1E1 retained after reopening. User report only; no private file or database inspected.
androidPhysicalDevice.fullTVmazeBackupRestore: deferred by the owner on 2026-10-25, not marked passed

verifiedBaseline.otherFormatsScope: Eight programmes in build18; one basic physical episode save/reopen confirmed by owner. Remaining device tests deferred, not certified.

currentWebValidation.scope: Applied guest-first-access code, no new installed APK.

identityAndCompatibility: Preserve all existing local movie IDs 1-1000 and their associated personal data.
Use source plus media type plus external ID for imported identities; the same numerical TMDb ID for a movie and TV series must never collide.
Represent seasons and episodes explicitly. Series progress distinguishes want-to-watch, watching, completed, paused and abandoned.
Version personal storage and backup changes. Keep legacy and v1-v4 import compatibility, preferences and unmapped records without destructive normalization.
Keep the six existing storage key names and native package identity through the current persistence preparation; a display-name change does not justify abandoning installed personal data.

requirements: Licensed data and images for the intended commercial use.
Country, offer type, source and verification time; distinguish an unavailable lookup from a verified absence of offers.
Prefer verified title-specific official destinations; label subscription offers when the destination is not that title.
Preserve offline personal-library access and avoid presenting outdated availability as a guarantee.
whereToWatch.affiliatePolicy: Use only approved programs and valid issued tracking links. Clearly label remunerated recommendations. Do not assume that a click or playback earns commission or that one network permits combining another tracking identifier.
whereToWatch.potentialPartner: Amazon Associados Brasil is a researched candidate, not an approved integration or a revenue guarantee.
whereToWatch.commercialAndStoreReview: Confirm data rights, partner approval, disclosures and the concrete Android/iOS outbound-purchase flow before publishing.

growthPolicy: Thousands of titles is a supported product direction, not a claim that new formats already exist in the current app. Add verified content in batches only after the typed model, backups and measured performance are ready.
